The Tamashii Nations Robot Spirits Unicorn Gundam Full Armor Figure is a meticulously crafted collectible that brings the iconic Unicorn Gundam to life in its full armor form. Manufactured by Bandai Spirits, this figure boasts exceptional articulation and detailed design, making it a standout piece for any Gundam enthusiast. Its renewed joints are specifically designed to accommodate the additional armor parts, enhancing both playability and display options.

This action figure includes an impressive array of interchangeable hands and weaponry, such as the beam magnum, beam saber, hyper bazooka, shield, and beam gatling. It is also compatible with the AGP Unicorn Gundam MS Girl series, offering versatile display possibilities. Released in 2014, this figure remains a coveted item for collectors seeking high-quality Gundam representations.

Details

• Specifications:

  • Interchangeable hands
  • Multitude of weapons
  • Compatible with AGP Unicorn Gundam MS Girl

• Item dimensions: 5.08 x 7.62 x 13.97 cm

• Condition: Brand New

• Manufacturer: Bandai Spirits

• Release Date: April 19, 2014

• Recommended Age: 15+

Features

  • Includes replacement left and right wrists for varied posing options
  • Equipped with multiple weapons including beam magnum, beam saber, hyper bazooka, shield, and beam gatling
  • Renewed joints designed to attach full armor parts enhancing playability
  • Compatible with AGP Unicorn Gundam MS Girl figures for expanded display possibilities
  • Precision-made collectible requiring careful handling due to delicate parts

Care instructions

Handle the figure with care to avoid color transfer and scratches as it is precision-made. Clean gently with a soft cloth and avoid using water or harsh chemicals to preserve paint and material integrity. Store away from direct sunlight and dust to maintain color and condition. When assembling or disassembling parts, proceed carefully to prevent damage to joints and accessories.
